title: Peter defends the conversion of the Gentiles
description: Peter goes up to Jerusalem and is confronted by the circumcised for having entered and eaten with uncircumcised men. He explains in order the vision in Joppa with the sheet lowered from heaven containing all kinds of animals, and the voice that said what God has cleansed should not be called unclean. He tells about the three men from Caesarea, about the angel the man had seen, and how the Holy Spirit fell on the Gentiles while he was speaking, just as it did on the apostles at the beginning. When they heard this, they were silent, praised God, and acknowledged that God had also given the Gentiles repentance unto life.
